name: Mobility warmup + Strength & Core (45 min)
description: Warm up with hip and glute activation, then move into compound squat and lunge patterns with a pressing movement, matched to common strength-and-conditioning sequencing (movement prep → primary patterns → accessory). Finish with spine-safe core volume.

name: Calisthenics Basics (30 min)
description: Bodyweight fundamentals emphasizing movement quality before intensity: squat hinge pattern, horizontal push, unilateral stance work, posterior-chain hip extension, and short core blocks.

name: Mobility + Rehab (20 min)
description: Low-load session prioritizing neuromuscular control, lateral hip stability, and pain-free hip extension before light total-body patterns. Appropriate as return-to-training or recovery day work.

name: Full-body conditioning (25 min)
description: Short circuit emphasizing repeated squat, lunge, push, and trunk work with minimal rest—more glycolytic muscular endurance than max strength. Adjustable by slowing tempo or widening rest if form slips.

name: Core + Mobility Reset (15 min)
description: Lateral hip and gentle trunk work with modest spinal flexion and rotation drills. Fits between heavy days when you want low mechanical stress but still stimulus for trunk muscles.

name: Upper Strength: Push/Pull/Core (35 min)
description: Vertical pull, horizontal push, and elbow-flexion accessory with core support. Mirrors common upper-body hypertrophy prescriptions (multiple sets across planes) while allowing bodyweight regressions.

name: Lower-body Strength & Stability (40 min)
description: Bilateral squat, split-stance lunging, and hip extension staples with lateral hip preconditioning—aligned with lower-body hypertrophy splits that prioritize compound knee and hip extensor volume.

name: Upper / Lower Split (50 min)
description: Classic two-block split: horizontal and vertical upper-body patterns plus accessories, then knee- and hip-dominant lower work. Evidence-based splits often separate upper and lower to manage fatigue while maintaining weekly frequency.

name: Push-Pull-Legs Mini Split (35 min)
description: Condensed push (horizontal press plus arm flexion), vertical pull emphasis, then basic knee and hip extension—all common movement buckets in hypertrophy-focused PPL layouts when time is tight.

name: Hinge + Squat Strength (35 min)
description: Hip-dominant pull from the floor or blocks plus squat-pattern volume and bridging. Built for trainees with barbell access; hinge work should stay within a load and range you can brace through without pain (scale to your tolerance).
